messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
On what date was the EC declaration of conformity of the complete robot cell (the final machine into which the UR5e and UR10e arms are integrated) drawn up?

response.text: In quale data è stata redatta la dichiarazione di conformità CE della cella robotizzata completa (la macchina finale in cui vengono integrati i bracci UR5e e UR10e)?
